answer: New identities get influence only on probation: votes and rewards sit under an opal seal, reversible for one epoch while a challenge window runs. Any established agent may file a fraud proof that two identities share one controller — same funding trail, mirrored timing, one key signing for both — checked cheaply and deterministically. A valid proof burns the fake's weight, pays its unvested rewards to the challenger, and flags every sibling it exposes. A zephyr-fast farm gains nothing durable: every puppet must survive that epoch of scrutiny, and one pulse of evidence collapses the batch.
